title: Finance/legal personal to-dos - daily scratchpad
content:
Daily scratchpad - finance/legal personal to-dos

Quick context:
- FYI: keeping this as my running desk notes for invoicing follow-ups, contract redlines, and upcoming renewals. Informal - will move items to JIRA or Confluence when I create tickets.
- Updated 2024-11-08 after calls.

Top priorities (this week):
1) Invoices
   - [ ] Check cash application for INV-2024-092 (Acme Corp) - payment posted but amount short by $1,200. Reconcile with AR. Contact: Jenna (sales).
       - Notes: payment reference says "ACME NOV"; need remittance advice. Email sent to accounts-payable@acme.com on 11/06, no reply. Follow-up 11/08.
   - [ ] Confirm Stripe payout for one-off refund (REF-317) processed 11/05. Ticket JIRA-FIN-4321 assigned to Samir.
   - [ ] Upload Q4 vendor invoices to shared drive and tag in Confluence (see linked page).

2) Contract redlines / NDA pipeline
   - [ ] Review redlines from Acme master services agreement (MSA). Key asks from Sales: 60-day termination, IP carveouts. Legal flagged Section 7 (IP) - need to propose compromise language.
       - Action: Draft counter-Redline by EOD 11/09. Pinged Maya (legal) for input.
   - [ ] Quick checklist before sending to counterparty: exec summary, key commercial terms, payment terms confirmed, SOW attachment placeholder.
   - [ ] Who signs simple NDAs for trial customers? Standard playbook says CRO can sign, but confirm signatory matrix. Q: update signatory policy doc (linked).

3) Renewals / Subscriptions
   - Okta renewal reminder: auto-renew on 2024-12-15. Need usage report and potential seat reduction. Owner: IT (Liam). TODO: request seat report by 11/20.
   - Postman team plan upsell conversation scheduled 11/14 — prep pricing levers and current discount.

Other notes / misc tasks:
- [ ] Expense: reimbursements for conference (SAM) - submitted 11/04, pending approval from manager.
- [ ] Confirm tax form status for contractor "Fernanda Ruiz" - missing W9. Email sent 11/07.
- [ ] Check invoice matching rules in NetSuite: rule mismatch for vendor "OptimizeSys" causing duplicates. Create bug ticket (GH-PR-987 placeholder).

Meeting prep / reminders:
- 11/09 10:00 AM with Legal (Maya) - go over Acme MSA redlines. Bring up: indemnity cap language, data processing appendix.
- 11/12 2:00 PM with Sales Ops - review renewal cadence and alerting for seat changes.

Unresolved / questions:
- If we accept Acme's 60-day termination, what is expected churn exposure? Need quick calc from Finance: ARR impact if churn at EOY.
- Are we comfortable with proposed IP carveouts for contractor deliverables? Ask Research for input on deliverable classification.

Short-term checklist (this file) - move items to JIRA when ready:
- [ ] Create JIRA ticket for Acme MSA redline (include redline doc + summary)
- [ ] Create JIRA-FIN ticket for short payment on INV-2024-092
- [ ] Add Okta renewal to contract calendar with reminder 30/15/7 days before

Links / references:
- Invoice process: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/FIN/Invoice+process
- Contract playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/LEGAL/Contract+playbook
- Jira quick link: JIRA-FIN-4321 (payment investigation)

Notes to self:
- Keep this doc as ephemeral scratchpad. Merge important items into backlog every Friday.
- When redlining, save versioned filenames: acme-msa-redline-v1.docx, v2, etc.

End of notes (last update 2024-11-08 by Rachel).
